title: test_multihop_latency_bounds.py: min_us assertion conflicts with relay-only LatencyRule
description:
P1 CORRECTNESS: In test_latency_bounded_with_added_delay, line 372 asserts 'stats.min_us >= 50_000' but the LatencyRule only applies delay to the relay node. The relay->dst hop (line 344) has no delay and polls at 1ms into airtime. Since metrics aggregate all hops, min_us will include the non-delayed dst reception (~1ms), causing this assertion to fail.

Fix options:
- Remove this assertion since the chaos delay is already validated by the max_expected bound on line 366
- Or filter stats to relay-only receptions (requires API change)

Discovered by: 3x codereview (correctness pass)
File: python/tests/sim/test_multihop_latency_bounds.py
Line: 372
close_reason: Fixed: removed incorrect min_us >= 50_000 assertion since LatencyRule only applies to relay node. Added comment explaining the max_expected bound is sufficient.
